organ_site.rule: Project design (user 2026-11-13): mamu and peni share the standard body's front lower site at the same height above the ground contact (rounded surface_site y 1.281), not scaled by the long body; the peni shift puts its exit there, the mamu shift centres the turned mark on the front skin, standing as proud of the skin at full extension as the standard body's mark (0.125).

separation: Congenital shape is saved separately from species and acquired wounds. The bean form and named subspecies are mutually exclusive.
reference_notes: Geometric ratios are original Minecraft adaptation; no intelligence, vision or food incapacity is inferred from appearance.
